name: guidelytech/guidely-php
description: Guidely feature flags and experiments for PHP: local evaluation, caching, sticky bucketing, remote evaluation and encrypted payloads.

suggest.ext-openssl: Required to decrypt encrypted flag payloads
suggest.ext-curl: Faster HTTP transport (falls back to PHP streams when missing)
suggest.ext-apcu: Shared in-memory payload cache via GuidelyTech\Flags\Cache\ApcuCache
suggest.psr/simple-cache-implementation: Any PSR-16 cache (Redis, Memcached, Symfony, Laravel) can hold the payload
